fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2026-03-20 states that the proprietor of Kalai Home Appliances noticed missing stock (stationery items) valued at Rs. 1,20,000 near Anbu Park Main Street in Trichy, on 2026-03-18 at about 13:10. Jagan Sekar approached Trichy Central PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000355. The complainant is associated with the business Kalai Home Appliances. A further person, Jeeva Muthu, a driver, using the number 9000000124, is stated to be associated with the incident. A witness, Buvaneswari Sri, reachable on 9000000294, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Nithin Velan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000004.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as a customer and took items while staff were attending to others.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, witness, associate, CCTV, main street, mobile number, suspect
